latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Free Windows — Edit and export videos easily on any Windows PC.

- Allows users to upload and edit video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) with free cloud-based AI rendering.
- 1080p MP4 export supported without installing paid software; full process takes 1-2 minutes per video.
- Smart intent matching: recognizes prompts for export, upload, credits, status, and editing commands.
- Simple onboarding with free token generation (100 credits, valid 7 days); setup is automatic and minimal.
- Full export workflow and error handling included, with timeline summaries and common troubleshooting tips.
